checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same woman at kitchen table, framing and sequence preserved
must.why: The scene matches the source closely. The woman looks a little different (face drift) but is still recognizable.

must.item: Supplied orange-hoodie fox in top-right corner from first to last frame
must.why: The fox is a redrawn sticker in the bottom-right corner, not the supplied art and not top-right. It is visible in every frame.

must.item: Fox has no white rectangular background and is not clipped
must.why: The fox sits on a white sticker-like border and is cut off at the right and bottom edges.

must.item: Logo remains small and does not obscure the face
must.why: The logo is small and far from the face.

must.item: Original speech audible and synchronized throughout
must.why: The audio can't be judged. The clip has sound, but the AI re-render may have changed lip sync.

faults.what: The logo is an AI redraw, not the supplied fox. Its details are changed, such as a blue-and-white fox with a different outfit.
The logo is in the bottom-right corner, not top-right. It is clipped at the frame edge and has a white sticker background.
The AI re-render altered the woman's face and expression slightly, and the video is softer and lower resolution.

summary: The clip keeps the woman and the kitchen, but the logo is a redrawn lookalike fox with a white border, placed bottom-right and clipped at the edges, so it is not the supplied fox in the top-right corner.
